speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing a chronic cough, weight loss, and generalized weakness. To begin our evaluation, how long have you had these symptoms, and have you noticed any blood in your sputum or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given the significant weight loss, night sweats, fever, and your recent release from prison, these symptoms are highly concerning for an infectious disease like tuberculosis. Have you had any contact with anyone who had a chronic cough or known infections recently?
